title: Logo & brand identity
short: A first impression that feels like you.
description: Custom logo and brand identity design by Desira. A thoughtful visual language built around your business, your audience, and the story you want to tell.
heading: Give your brand its own kind of presence.
body: Your identity is the way your business introduces itself. We explore your story and turn it into a visual direction that feels distinctive and works across your chosen touchpoints. The exact deliverables are agreed around your brief.
alt: Sample Mora Coffee identity board with a green wordmark, monogram and takeaway cup

title: Posters & print design
short: Good ideas, beautifully put on paper.
description: Custom posters, brochures and print design by Desira. Clear messages and expressive visuals for your brand, campaign, or occasion.
heading: Make your message worth a closer look.
body: From a single poster to a multi-page brochure, we balance visual impact with a clear message. We discuss where the design will be seen, what it needs to say, and the format it needs to work in before bringing the idea to life.
deliverables: Final artwork prepared to the agreed specifications
alt: Desira’s brochure design combining editorial typography, photography and structured page layouts

title: Wedding invitations
short: For a day, and a story, unlike any other.
description: Personalised wedding invitations, illustrated save-the-dates and wedding stationery by Desira. Custom designs that bring your story into every detail.
heading: Your forever starts with a very personal hello.
body: Your invitation sets the feeling for everything to come. We take cues from your story, your traditions, and your celebration to create a design that feels like yours. From a coastal monogram to a custom couple illustration, the details carry the personality.
alt: A custom invitation by Desira combining floral illustration, traditional motifs and a soft pink palette

title: Event graphics
short: Turn a space into an experience.
description: Custom event graphics and visual design by Desira. Cohesive graphics for signage, entrances, and the details that bring a celebration to life.
heading: Take your idea beyond the screen.
body: An event is a collection of moments, spaces, and details. We create graphics that connect those pieces through a shared visual theme. Working from the brief and production requirements, we help translate your idea into the real world.
deliverables: Artwork coordinated with agreed production requirements
alt: The entrance to Toca Boca kids carnival with colourful event signage and graphics by Desira
